title: Aristotle: the planets are intelligences

tellings.quote: I mean they're not for Aristotle, you know, I mean literally the planets are intelligences, right? So they're not flying ships or something like that.

plain: For Aristotle, the ancient Greek philosopher, the planets were literally intelligences, thinking beings, and not anything like flying ships. James Madden, a guest who brings ancient philosophy to the question of UFOs, makes this point on Michels's show from his own reading, to show how differently older thinkers understood the lights in the sky.
